# I Need Barcode

> I Need Barcode is a free, browser-based barcode and QR Code generator at https://ineedbarcode.com. It requires no registration, adds no watermark, supports more than 100 barcode formats, and exports print-ready PNG files.

## Primary capabilities

- Generate QR Code, Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, and 100+ other formats.
- Create codes for URLs, Wi-Fi credentials, contacts, email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, locations, and events.
- Generate up to 100 barcodes in bulk.
- Customize colors, module size, rotation, shapes, dots, frames, and transparent backgrounds.
- Process barcode data in the browser and download PNG output without creating an account.
